{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''smuggling ring''' made up of members of the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] operated from [[Syvris shadowport]], near [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] ran supplies for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], an activity that brought them to the attention of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after an Imperial [[Raid on the Ulkantha asteroids|raid]] on the [[Ulkantha asteroids]] produced evidence of the clandestine activity. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], then led a second [[Raid on Syvris shadowport|raid]] on the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] to break up the Sakiyan organization.
